title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Interpretive Note: Holiday Pay in a Week of Weekly Payment
content:
For a weekly payment on Unemployment Benefit Claims, holiday pay reported on the week's certification is treated according to the hours the claimant worked in that week, against one day's hours of 8.

## The rule

| Holiday pay reported; hours worked in the week | Treatment |
|---|---|
| Some hours, but fewer than 8 | The holiday pay is added to the week's earnings as counted earnings and is not deducted as other pay |
| At least 8 | One half (0.5) of the holiday pay is deducted as other pay, rounded to the cent |

Counted earnings are the week's gross earnings together with any holiday pay added to them under the first row; they are the earnings measured against the disregard.

This treatment does not reach holiday pay reported for a week with no hours worked, nor any other kind of other pay.

## Points of interpretation (hypothetical figures)

| Gross earnings | Hours | Holiday pay | Counted earnings | Holiday pay deducted as other pay |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 60.00 | 4.0 | 120.00 | 180.00 | None |
| 150.00 | 10.0 | 120.00 | 150.00 | 60.00 |
| 0.00 | 8.0 | 120.00 | 0.00 | 60.00 |
